turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on am, is and are?
turns.tutor:
First, I will show you one. "You ___ a doctor." I check the first word: you. You always goes with are. So: You are a doctor.
The rule in one line: am with I, is with he, she or it, are with you, we or they.
Right: He is a doctor. Wrong: He are a doctor.

Now it is your turn. Write am, is or are: I ___ a student. (answer with only the missing word)
